messages:
harper: Quick PSA — onboarding CLI sample caused duplicated webhook calls when auth refresh returned a 429. small race between refresh retry and original send.

nik: can you paste the minimal logs/repro?

harper: sure. sequence: client tries call -> 401 -> refresh starts -> auth returns 429 -> client retries immediately -> webhook gets sent twice. tiny log: 
```
2026-03-23T09:12:00Z app req=run42 status=401 refresh=start
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z auth refresh id=run42 result=429
2026-03-23T09:12:01Z app retry attempt=1 send webhook id=run42
2026-03-23T09:12:02Z app retry attempt=2 send webhook id=run42
```

zane: classic amplification. what does the SDK default backoff do?

nik: CLI SDK had linear backoff hardcoded (delay = 300ms * attempt) and no jitter option exposed. webhook client also didn't send Idempotency-Key by default.

harper: proposal: (A) add "staggered full jitter" for auth refresh (full jitter but seeded per-process to avoid thundering herd on cold restart), (B) middleware that attaches Idempotency-Key derived from payload.operation_id when available, opt-out by header, (C) e2e harness that simulates 429-on-refresh and asserts at-most-once per operation_id.

zane: love the seeded jitter idea — keeps randomness but makes distributed tests reproducible. implementation: seed = H(process_uuid, epoch_minute) then rand(seed, 0..max).

nik: will add jitter enum to SDK config: [none,fixed,full,seeded_full] default seeded_full for new CLI, fall back for legacy. also emit metric cli.retry.refresh_jitter_ms.

qa-bot: test plan: run harness 5k iterations with auth 429 on first refresh, enforce <=1 webhook per operation_id; report flaky rate.

harper: i'll own middleware + README note recommending idempotency-by-default for outgoing side-effects. will also wire the QA harness into CI smoke tests.

zane: small UX note: document how to opt-out for local debugging (header X-Allow-Duplicate: true).

harper: great. will open two tiny PRs (sdk jitter + middleware) and link them here. QA run before we cut the sample release. :white_check_mark:
